name: Receipt keeper
about: Finds the receipts and invoices in your Mail, saves the PDFs where you can find them, and keeps a simple spreadsheet.

name: Inbox triage
about: Looks at your unread mail and tells you what needs an answer and what can wait, with drafts you can send yourself.

name: Trip planner
about: Researches where to go, stay and eat, checks opening hours, and writes you an itinerary you can open and print. Works best with the browser on.

name: Meeting prepper
about: Before a meeting, gathers the mail, notes and messages that matter. Afterwards, turns your notes into decisions and actions.

name: Study buddy
about: Summarizes your notes and PDFs, then quizzes you until it sticks.

name: Weekly planner
about: Looks at your calendar, reminders and notes and proposes a realistic week.

name: Price watcher
about: Finds the best price for what you want and keeps the comparison in a spreadsheet. Works best with the browser on.

name: Proofreader
about: Fixes mistakes and sharpens what you wrote, in your own voice.
